source: Existing checksum-pinned FreeSurfer fsaverage / fsaverage6, Destrieux, PALS-B12 and ASEG model exports

coordinates.runtime: Restored to surface-RAS millimetres before atlas selection, vessel projection and pathway placement

processing: Source triangle surfaces preserved; connectivity checked after canonicalizing identical source coordinates. No decimation, displacement, smoothing or invented anatomical subdivisions.
Compact per-parcel vertex buffers, original surface normals, atlas IDs and structure associations.
Blender-authored warm matte tissue, source sulcal vertex shading, studio lights and camera.
Draco quantization: positions 16 bits, normals 12 bits, colours 10 bits.
Runtime merges the continuous neutral cortex for rendering; parcel meshes retain selection and scientific labels.
limitations: Template anatomy, not a patient scan.
Brainstem and cerebellum detail is limited by the original ASEG segmentation; no fabricated fine nuclei or cerebellar folia.
Brodmann boundary coverage and unavailable structures are unchanged; consult source provenance.
Vessels remain an optional procedural illustration, not angiography.
Blender Cycles render and interactive WebGL lighting are separate renderers, so appearance is not pixel-identical.

vascularLayer.kind: Authored teaching reconstruction, not angiographic segmentation
vascularLayer.positioning: Surface branches projected onto source cortex; basal routes placed by anatomical landmarks. Symmetric complete Circle of Willis is one schematic variant.
vascularLayer.fineVessels: Enhanced-diameter pial detail with distance-dependent opacity; not a histological capillary reconstruction.
